notes.title: STRIKERS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The STRIKERS Arcade update is now here! 

Play the indie 1-hit fighting game now with an all-new single-player mode! 
This update includes new maps, game modes, music, sounds, effects, mechanics, lore, skins, and more!

Game Features
LOCAL MULTIPLAYER 1v1 matches including Team Duals and LOCAL CLASH MODE  
Play SINGLE PLAYER ARCADE mode to unlock Character Skins and Lore 
Try out TRAINING MODE to test out Characters and hone your skills!  
CLASH MODE 
Intro TUTORIAL


MORE COMING SOON!

notes.title: Arcade Single-Player Update Coming 2023!!!!
notes.content:
Hello and thank you to everyone who has played my game STRIKERS. 
I'm happy to share that I'm working on a free update! The focus is Single-Player

Expect to see the Arcade Single-Player Update coming in 2023!

The Update will include the following:

- Arcade mode!
- Skins! With at least 4 unlockable skins for each character
- Lore for characters unlocked through Arcade
- Training Mode! Test against CPUs
- Clash Mode!
- New and Updated Maps
- New and Updated Music 
- Full Keyboard support 
- Updated Effects and sounds

- And more!!
